key.name: rules-desktop
key.description: Used when the pointer is over the empty desktop; if none matches, the shell rules are tried. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id); the mouse wheel is button 4 (up) and 5 (down). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-shell
key.description: Used when the pointer is over a Shell surface such as the top bar. Presses over application windows never reach the extension. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id); the mouse wheel is button 4 (up) and 5 (down). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-overview
key.description: Used while the overview is open. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id); the mouse wheel is button 4 (up) and 5 (down). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-app-grid
key.description: Used while the app grid is showing. The app grid page actions turn its pages. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id); the mouse wheel is button 4 (up) and 5 (down). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: wrap-workspaces
key.description: Previous on the first workspace goes to the last one, and next on the last goes to the first. Also applies to moving a window. Does not apply to app grid pages.

key.name: wheel-threshold
key.description: How much wheel scrolling one action needs, in notches (1 = one click of a notched wheel). The amounts of events in one direction add up until this value is reached.

key.name: wheel-min-interval
key.description: After a wheel action, wheel events are ignored for this many milliseconds, so one burst of scrolling runs one action.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: For troubleshooting: write one line per mouse button press or wheel event to the journal.
